item.text: The workshop had six workbenches, giving learners dedicated space to practice projects side by side. Tools were hung on accessible wall racks, so everyone could find and return what they needed without interrupting instruction. Scrap wood was sorted into labeled bins by size and type, making it easy to select materials for small exercises and reducing waste. The organized layout helped participants focus on learning practical skills, from measuring and cutting to assembling pieces safely.
